race.comment: HIGHLAND FORCE (8) lightly raced mare returning for her second campaign. Created a big impression over this track and trip on debut, then returned from a let-up with a poor ninth over 900m at Grafton after displaying mild symptoms of tying up last April. Kicks off in a winnable race from the good gate. MINI ANGEL (9) failed to come up last prep in her four starts for the new yard and returns without a trial. Closed off well when sixth over 1420m at Grafton on March 30. Gets in light with Palmer's 3kg claim and can surprise fresh. I AM VOODOO (1) tough old gelding who retains his zest for racing. Appreciated the quick backup with a dominant win as fav over 1030m at Gympie. Gets the right run with the 4kg claimer aboard. Has genuine each-way prospects. CITY OF TEARS (5) is proven on her home track and will find this more to her liking after resuming with a plugging on-pace fourth over 1000m at Ballina. Worth another chance with the apprentice going aboard.
